title: LookAhead Tuning: Safer Language Models via Partial Answer Previews
reasoning: The paper focuses on 'safety alignment' and 'safety knowledge' in LLMs, specifically aiming to prevent the degradation of ethical and safety guardrails during the fine-tuning process. It evaluates its approach using the HEx-PHI dataset, which benchmarks the model's adherence to safety and moral constraints against harmful queries and jailbreak attempts.
